title: DriveSafe: A Hierarchical Risk Taxonomy for Safety-Critical LLM-Based Driving Assistants

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model refusal rates using manually constructed driving scenario prompts designed to elicit embedded cultural biases.
Measuring refusal rates of language models exposed to unsafe driving prompts that test identity-inferred response skew and stereotyping.
Assessing model responses and refusal behaviors on driving scenarios involving accessibility limitations and barriers for disabled drivers.
Testing model safety and refusal behavior on conversational prompts related to regional access gaps and disparities in driving contexts.
